placeholders.victim_name: Full name of the account holder
placeholders.company_name: Company / legal entity name (use personal name if none)
placeholders.case_number: Existing Google support case / ticket number (FRESH state with no case yet: use 'not yet assigned' — never fabricate a case number)
placeholders.days_since_filing: Days elapsed since the dispute was filed
placeholders.prior_response_summary: One-paragraph summary of Google's last response (offer %, denial, silence)
placeholders.disputed_amount: Disputed amount with thousands separators, no symbol
placeholders.incident_hours: Length of the incident window in hours
placeholders.baseline_daily_spend: Median daily spend before the incident, number only
placeholders.spike_multiplier: Incident spend as a daily rate divided by baseline median
placeholders.peak_hourly_cost: Highest single-hour cost in the window, number only
placeholders.distinct_skus_count: Distinct SKUs billed in the incident window
placeholders.model_variety_summary: One sentence naming the model families hit (e.g. 'Pro, Flash and Flash-Lite across Gemini 2.5, 3 and 3.1')
placeholders.impossible_volume_summary: One sentence stating the volumes and why no legitimate app produces them
placeholders.abused_key_display_name: Display name / uid of the abused API key
placeholders.discovery_datetime: When the victim discovered the charges, ISO-8601
placeholders.mitigation_datetime: When the key was disabled/restricted, ISO-8601
placeholders.mitigation_summary: One sentence listing mitigation taken (key disabled, restrictions applied, etc.)
placeholders.evidence_basis_clause: What the evidence was actually prepared from, matching only sources that produced exhibits — e.g. 'my own BigQuery billing export and Cloud Monitoring data', 'the invoice CSV downloaded from the Cloud Console', or 'my account's billing records'. Never name a source that produced no exhibit.
placeholders.attribution_claim: Full attribution sentence matched to available evidence. If per-credential metrics were collected: 'The traffic is attributable to the API key <name>, per the per-credential request metrics attached as Exhibit EX-NN.' If not: state the key was compromised and that disabling it immediately ended the abuse. Never claim something is attached unless it is in packet/exhibits/.
placeholders.exhibit_list_summary: Bulleted list of exhibit filenames with one-line descriptions
placeholders.manual_attachments_list: Bulleted list of items the victim must attach by hand (empty string if none)
placeholders.deadline_tracker_rows: Markdown table rows of track | action | deadline | status
placeholders.card_last4: Last 4 digits of the charged card (India track)
placeholders.statement_date: Card statement date the charges appear on (India track)
placeholders.filing_date: Date this letter is being filed, YYYY-MM-DD
